recognize_zh: 紅血球背景中有一小團約七顆彼此黏著的大細胞，細胞質灰紫並充滿透明空泡，核有明顯藍色核仁，這種成團、帶空泡且非造血的細胞是骨髓轉移性癌的線索。
features: Small cohesive cluster of about seven large cells sharing cell borders
Round to oval nuclei with granular chromatin and prominent blue nucleoli
Moderate grey-purple cytoplasm with numerous small clear vacuoles
Cells far larger than surrounding red cells; relatively high N:C ratio
Background of red cells with stacking; no admixed hematopoietic cells in the cluster
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small cohesive cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells in a background of red cells. The cells have round to oval nuclei with granular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and moderate grey-purple cytoplasm containing numerous clear vacuoles. The tight cohesion with shared borders is not a feature of normal marrow elements. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with breast primary in this patient; immunohistochemical confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a distant pale hof and small nucleoli, and are not tightly cohesive with vacuolated cytoplasm.
Burkitt cells are vacuolated but discohesive, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and CD45/CD20/CD10 expression.
Plasma cells have eccentric clock-face nuclei with perinuclear hof and are CD138 positive, cytokeratin negative.
